node.title: Re: Leaking Function Return
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
this is my first post on here. If I am violating any rules, I apologize in advance. Also, if you see a simple way I can improve my conventions for coding

Welcome, and no worries, for a first post it's fine :-) Some good introductory reading is [id://213052], [id://972], and [id://174051]

Sorry, I can't reproduce the issue, neither with your original code with [doc://strict] turned off, or with it turned on and the appropriate [doc://my] declarations added (although I'm not surprised by the latter). Without seeing more code (a representative [id://1177642]), I can only guess: Either you're making a mistake somewhere in the "manipulations occur here producing a new array with 6 values", which you haven't shown us, or, since you're apparently not using [doc://strict], meaning all of those variables are global, there is some "cross-contamination" happening between the arrays (Update 2: I just wrote some more on that [id://1200840|here]). This is one reason you should always [id://111088]*, since it helps enforce proper scoping of your variables!

* Update: Your program should begin with this, see the [id://745674]:

use strict; use warnings; use diagnostics;
